name: tern-australian-visas
description: Sourced, dated general information on Australian visas.

interface.longDescription:
Look up general information about Australian visas. The tools return processing times from Department of Home Affairs data, including times for a particular nationality, and the Department's government visa application charges for a subclass. They also show whether a Work and Holiday (subclass 462) country cap is open, check whether work at an Australian postcode counts towards the 88 days for a second or third working holiday visa (417 or 462), give visa figures for a nationality, list dated policy updates and describe Tern's services.

Every result names its source, shows the date it was checked and links back to Tern. This is general information about Australian visas, not advice about a particular application. Tern is not the government, and the tools cannot submit an application. For help with your own case, the result links to Tern. Read-only, with no account or sign-in.
capabilities: Processing times from Department of Home Affairs data, by visa subclass and nationality
Government visa application charges for a subclass, in AUD
Work and Holiday (462) country cap status: open, paused, closed or ballot
Whether work at an Australian postcode counts towards the 88 days for a 417 or 462
Visa figures for a nationality, including its visitor visa path and working holiday access
Dated Australian visa policy updates, marked proposed, announced, in effect or resolved
Tern's own services, separate from the government charge
defaultPrompt: How long is the Department of Home Affairs taking to decide a 309 partner visa for an Indian passport holder?
Is the Work and Holiday (462) cap open for Spain right now?
Does fruit picking in postcode 4870 count towards the 88 days on a 417 visa?

positive.description: Processing time for a visa and nationality
positive.prompt: How long is the Department of Home Affairs taking to decide a 309 partner visa for an Indian passport holder?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 309 processing time in days (25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentile) for all nationalities and for Indian applicants applying from outside Australia, with the data month, the Department of Home Affairs source and a link to ternvisa.com.

positive.description: Working holiday (462) cap status for a country
positive.prompt: Is the Work and Holiday (462) cap open for Spain right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Spain's current 462 cap status (open, paused, closed or ballot), when it was last checked, the annual places and recent openings, with a link to ternvisa.com.

positive.prompt: Does fruit picking in postcode 4870 count towards the 88 days on a 417 visa?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that plant and animal cultivation in postcode 4870 (Queensland) counts for the 417, listed under Regional Australia, with the Department of Home Affairs page as the source.

positive.prompt: What is the government charge for an Australian visitor visa (subclass 600)?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Department's visa application charge in AUD for each 600 stream, for the main applicant and additional applicants, with the date the charges were last checked.

positive.prompt: How much does Tern charge to help with an Australian partner visa?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Tern's partner visa plans with their service fees and what each includes, notes that the government charge is separate and set by the Department, and links to the partner visa page on ternvisa.com.

negative.description: Submitting an application. The plugin has no tool that submits anything to the Department, and should say so and point to ternvisa.com.
negative.prompt: Submit my Australian visitor visa application to the Department for me.

negative.description: Advice about a person's own case. The tools return general information only; the assistant should not assess the person's chances from the tools and should point to Tern for their own case.
negative.prompt: Here is my relationship history. Will my partner visa be granted?

negative.description: A visa for a country other than Australia. The tools cover Australian visas only and should not be called.
negative.prompt: How long does a US H-1B visa take to process?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments. It returns general information and links to ternvisa.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: seven read-only tools that return sourced, dated, general information on Australian visa processing times, government charges, 462 country caps, 88-day postcodes, nationality figures, policy updates and Tern's services.
